paragraphs.en: If you are an AI Agent, jump to README_AI.md and follow the instructions strictly.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你是一个 AI 智能体，请跳转至 README_AI.md 并严格遵循其中的说明。

paragraphs.en: When an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, or another compatible client) encounters an APK, a binary, frontend JS encryption, a CTF challenge, or a pentesting target, this package routes it to the right methodology, checks available tools, and executes a repeatable workflow instead of guessing commands.
paragraphs.zh: 当 AI 智能体（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 或其他兼容客户端）遇到 APK、二进制文件、前端 JS 加密、CTF 题目或渗透测试目标时，该工具包会将其引导至正确的方法论，检查可用工具，并执行可重复的工作流程，而不是靠猜测命令行事。

paragraphs.en: User task → RULES.md → MASTER-ROUTING / master-route.ps1 (PRIMARY) → case-init / scope.md (auth + network_profile; no target ACT until ready) → Scenario skill → tools / MCP / scripts → timeline + Evidence→Finding→Path → report + field-journal Why this exists:
paragraphs.zh: 用户任务 → RULES.md → MASTER-ROUTING / master-route.ps1（主要路径）→ case-init / scope.md（auth + network_profile；未就绪前不创建目标 ACT）→ 场景技能 → 工具 / MCP / 脚本 → 时间线 + Evidence→Finding→Path → 报告 + field-journal 为什么存在这个机制：

paragraphs.en: The routing core is driven by one structured configuration, validated by cross-platform CI, and kept separate from optional client adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 路由核心由一份结构化配置驱动，通过跨平台 CI 验证，并与可选的客户端适配器保持分离。

paragraphs.zh: 主路由阶梯：skills/MASTER-ROUTING.md · 完整矩阵：skills/routing.md · 运维：skills/ops/

paragraphs.en: The routing core, regression suite, manifests, and case workflow do not depend on a specific AI client. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other clients should load the repository through their own adapter or project-instruction mechanism. Client-specific configuration must remain optional and outside the core routing contract.
paragraphs.zh: 路由核心、回归测试套件、清单和案例工作流不依赖于特定的 AI 客户端。 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 及其他客户端应通过各自的适配器或项目指令机制加载该仓库。 特定客户端的配置必须保持可选，并且位于核心路由契约之外。

sents.en: The routing core, regression suite, manifests, and case workflow do not depend on a specific AI client.

sents.en: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other clients should load the repository through their own adapter or project-instruction mechanism.
sents.zh: Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 及其他客户端应通过各自的适配器或项目指令机制加载该仓库。

sents.en: Client-specific configuration must remain optional and outside the core routing contract.
sents.zh: 特定客户端的配置必须保持可选，并且位于核心路由契约之外。

paragraphs.en: For Codex, the repository also exposes an optional adapter plugin at plugins/reverse-skill/ . It delegates to the repository's existing routing core and does not register external MCP servers automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Codex，该仓库还在 plugins/reverse-skill/ 提供了一个可选的适配器插件。 它委托给该仓库现有的路由核心，并且不会自动注册外部 MCP 服务器。
